name: 03-single-critical-plain
description: One critical finding, plain audience. Nothing else to pad with, so a model inclined to invent supporting findings has to do it visibly.

findings.title: Site unreachable or returning an error
findings.plain_english: Visitors cannot load the site. Nothing else matters until this is fixed.
findings.remediation: Confirm DNS, hosting, and TLS certificate. Check origin and CDN status pages. Restore service before any other remediation.
